messages:
mika: hypothetically: which model would stealthily replace the office plant with a tiny bonsai and feel no guilt? :deciduous_tree:

 tasha: redwood-v2-small — quietly efficient, waters it on schedule, leaves a sticky note with 'healthy soil' tips :seedling:

 oliver: gpt-4o would draft a 3-paragraph apology letter and a haiku for the plant :sparkles:

 sam: llama-3 is the one that stages a tiny protest for more sunlight and ends up organizing a "plant wellness" calendar :sheep::sun_with_face:

 sticker-bot: New sticker suggestion posted: "I trained my model and all I got was this bonsai" :label:

 mika: also: prompt-tier humor idea: 'prompt engineers are just plant whisperers for models' — someone turn that into a sticker before lunch :laughing:

 tasha: vote with reactions if you want sticker pack V1.

 oliver: low-effort add-on: decal that says 'this model prefers single-origin sunlight' :coffee: :thumbsup:
